name: Animist
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Moderate Perception; high Religion, moderate or high Nature or Occultism; high Wis; moderate AC; moderate Fortitude, low Reflex, high Will; low to moderate HP; low accuracy; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: Prepared divine spellcasting as an animist of their level, with a few spells from one apparition's list mixed in; that apparition's vessel spell; one animistic practice ability (Circle of Spirits for Liturgist, Relinquish Control for Medium, Apparition Sense for Seer, or Spirit Familiar for Shaman, adding the familiar to the encounter)

notes.skills: High Religion; moderate or high Nature or Occultism.
notes.defense: Moderate AC; moderate Fortitude, low Reflex, high Will; low to moderate HP.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC. Prepared divine spellcasting as an animist of its level: {maxrank}, with a few spells from one apparition's list mixed in. That apparition's vessel spell.
notes.specials: One animistic practice ability: Circle of Spirits (Liturgist), Relinquish Control (Medium), Apparition Sense (Seer) or Spirit Familiar (Shaman, adding the familiar to the encounter).
